about: Real people named in portfolio filings, 14 Oct to 13 Nov 2026. Every fact comes from the company's own NSE filing and carries the exact words it rests on; tests/test_people.py checks each quote against the cached filing text. Years marked approx are derived (for example '16 years at KPMG' before 'joined in 2018').
